name: Endbringer
oracle_text:
Untap this creature during each other player's untap step.
{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
{C}, {T}: Target creature can't attack or block this turn.
{C}{C}, {T}: Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: {C}, {T}: Target creature can't attack or block this turn.

needs.what: a one-shot effect that makes the objects it names (here a targeted creature) unable to attack at all -- any player, planeswalker or battle -- until end of turn; paired with the existing cant_block op (duration this_turn) it says "target creature can't attack or block this turn"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cant_block covers the block half only. cant_attack_player with `objects` supports only the `while_counter` and `next_combat` durations (next_combat outlives this turn when the creature's controller has no further combat this turn, so it would lock the creature on its controller's next turn), and with `attacker` it restricts a whole player, not one creature. The `cant_attack` static lasts while its source is on the battlefield and can only read printed characteristics, so it cannot name a target or a turn. detain lasts until your next turn and also stops activated abilities; granting defender changes the creature's keywords. None is exact.
